name: markwork
description: Markdown workspace for humans and AI agents, with GTK 4 and GJS
author: Eka Putra <eka@ekaput.com>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/layers.mjs && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1 WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 gjs -m dist/run-tests.js --with-kanban-mouse
scripts.test:core:node: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/layers.mjs && vite build -c vite.node.config.ts && node dist-node/run-core-node.js
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/run-tests.js --with-kanban-mouse
scripts.bench: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/bench.js
scripts.bench:save: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/bench.js --save=bench/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).json
scripts.bench:compare: npm run build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 gjs -m dist/bench.js --compare=bench/baseline.json
scripts.test:live:forgejo: npm run build && set -a && { [ ! -f ./.env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x800x24' env GDK_BACKEND=x11 LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 gjs -m dist/run-tests.js --only-forgejo
scripts.test:live:forge: npm run build && set -a && { [ ! -f ./.env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && gjs -m dist/live-forge.js
scripts.test:live: npm run build && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && gjs -m dist/live-test.js
scripts.docs: npm run build && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$(mktemp -d) gjs -m dist/capture.js
